kitDescription: Velvet (SR/Wind/Supporter/Burst II, cd 20s, ammo 6, chargeFrames 60, chargeMultiplier 250, normalMult 69.04). An ammo-pouch supporter: S1 fills a 6000-round pouch at battle start + Burst-Stage-2 entry (and strips 5% enemy ammo — inert, no enemy entity), and on each out-of-FB full-charge shot self-buffs ATK ▲30.5% + Attack Damage ▲30.5% (3s). S2 is the payload: on each in-FB full-charge shot grants ALL allies ATK ▲25.2%-of-caster (flat) + Charge Damage ▲100.8% (3s), and after 50 in-FB normals grants self Attack Damage ▲15.03% (5s) + 400.92% flatDamage rider. Burst swaps to a rapid weapon (7%/shot, 10s) with self Attack Damage ▲34.52% (10s).

skill2.kitLine: Full Charge DURING Full Burst → all allies ATK ▲25.2% of caster's ATK + Charge Damage ▲100.8% (3s)
skill2.finding: shotFired + fbGate:'inFb' → allies. casterAtkPct 25.2 (FLAT add of Velvet's ATK, resolves >1000 at apply ≈25133) NOT atkPct (target's own ATK scaler); chargeDamagePct 100.8 (additive charge-bucket points) NOT chargeDamageMultPct (base-charge multiplier). All allies incl. self (slots 0/1/2). Three nearest-wrongs discriminated: drop-inFb (applies outside FB), atkPct (value 25.2 scaler + casterAtkPct=0), chargeDamageMultPct. Documented caveat (not asserted): the buff is kept alive by swapped shots in her own burst window — 'Full Charge' identity of swap shots is measurement-gated ⚑.

skill2.kitLine: After landing 50 normal attacks during FB → self Attack Damage ▲15.03% (5s) + 400.92% flatDamage
skill2.disposition: FAITHFUL encoding, DOCUMENTED-GAP on counting fidelity
skill2.finding: hitCount:50 + fbGate:'inFb' → self attackDamagePct 15.03/5s + enemy flatDamage 400.92 (bucket skill; no core/crit/range clause → none granted; lands in FB by timing so +50% major applies). Faithful encoding fires ZERO procs in this 180s fixture (an SR lands ~10 in-FB hits/window « 50) — a NON-VACUOUS absence: both counterfactuals fire (drop-inFb → 2 out-of-FB procs; hitCount 5 → 10 in-FB procs at atkPct=400.92 + self 15.03/5s). ⚑ cumulative-vs-in-FB-only counting + per-FB reset is not expressible in the engine (hitCount counts all cumulative hits; fbGate gates fire-time only); both readings converge on 0 procs here, so the choice is inert/damage-neutral in this fixture. Classified DOCUMENTED-GAP (fidelity hypothesis), NOT a modeled≠working silent drop nor a REAL-GOTCHA — the fable S2b FIX flag agrees.

burst.kitLine: Changes the weapon: Damage 7% of final ATK, 10 sec
burst.finding: burstCast → weaponSwap damagePct:7, durationSec:10 — REPLACES the SR (swap shots at atkPct=7 inside the 10s window vs 69.04 outside; V5 discriminates against damagePct 70). Swap cadence/ammo/weapon-class are KIT-SILENT (ALWAYS-⚑ #3): engine fires a default ~10 shots/10s (S6 blind estimate pullsPerSec 12); shipped flagged with recipe (datamine burst swap shot_id, or count shots per window on video). CALIBRATED tier.

burstCast → self attackDamagePct 34.52, durationSec:10, once per Velvet cast. Keyed to HER burstCast, NOT fullBurstEnter — discriminable in the sole-B2 fixture (burstCast 10 ≠ fullBurstEnter 5). Three nearest-wrongs discriminated: fullBurstEnter (fires 5× not 10×), duration 3s (180f≠600f), and the co-terminous swap-mult check.

gotchas: S2 ally support (casterAtkPct 25.2 + chargeDamagePct 100.8) rides SWAPPED shots during Velvet's own 10s burst-weapon window — whether the 7% swap weapon satisfies 'Full Charge' is unverified (⚑ measurement-gated, documented caveat). If the swap weapon does NOT full-charge, this in-FB team buff collapses to only non-velvet-burst (crown-cast) FBs. Not a divergence in this fixture; a footage spot-check item.
